records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Powerful portfolio performance: For the third quarter, total Chico’s FAS net sales grew 14.3% and comparable sales increased 16.5% versus last year’s third quarter, led by the Company’s apparel brands.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Consistent strong results: Chico's FAS posted $0.20 net income per diluted share for the third quarter, driven by strong comparable sales growth and selling, general and administrative expenses (“SG&A”) leverage.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At the end of the third quarter, inventories totaled $304 million compared to $278 million at the end of last year’s third quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the third quarter, gross margin was $207 million, or 40.0% of net sales, compared to $184 million, or 40.7% of net sales, in last year's third quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Solid operating income growth: Third quarter income from operations was $31.6 million, or 6.1% of net sales, compared to $22.0 million, or 4.9% of net sales, in last year’s third quarter, driven by strong sales growth and SG&A leverage, partially offset by higher raw material costs.
